content: जयः [जि भावे अच्] .²1 Conquest, triumph, victory, success, winning (in battle, game or a law-suit); सप्त वित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः क्रयो जयः <ls>Mb. 10. 115</ls>. .²2 Restraint, curbing, conquest as in इन्द्रियजय. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the sun. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of Jayanta, son of Indra; जगृहे च धनुर्धाता मुसलं तु जयस्तया <ls>Mb. 1. 227. 34</ls>. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Yudhiṣṭhira, the first Pāṇḍava prince. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of an attendant of Viṣṇu. .²7 An epithet of Arjuna; संस्मरन् भ्रातरं जयम् <ls>Mb. 3. 158. 2</ls>. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of the Mahābhārata; देवीं सरस्वतीं चैव ततो जयमुदीरयेत् <ls>Mb. 1. 1. 1</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 1. 2. 4</ls>; .²9 The heroic sentiment; सहजेतरौ जयशमौ दधती <ls>Ki. 6. 22</ls>. .²10 Words of victory; जयेन वर्धयित्वा च मारीचप्रमुखास्ततः <ls>Rām. 7. 23. 3</ls>. .{@-या@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of an attendant of the goddess Durgā. .²3 A kind of banner. .²4 The third, eighth or thirteenth lunar days of any of the two lunar fortnights.
